blocks.text: ATHENS, Greece — Paolo Bulgari, the grandson of a Greek silversmith who helped transform the family jewelry business into a global luxury brand synonymous with Italian glamour and design, has died. He was 89. His family announced his death Saturday, describing him as “the greatest jeweler of our time” and praising his humanity and entrepreneurial talent.
